mission: R2C-VFX LAB V2 — Simple Preset Composer Architecture

oldWorkflow.description: Low-level numeric QA calibration per action-step.
oldWorkflow.mentalModel: USE AS QA SOURCE -> tune 11 numeric fields -> VALIDATE -> APPLY -> VERIFY
problems: Automated numeric calibration produced animations perceived only as flashes
Spritesheets effectively invisible after all runtime multipliers stacked
fadeOut semantics misread as a duration instead of a normalized progress position
Timing compressed too aggressively against native cadence
Scale required repeated manual tuning per action and per AP tier
Visual spritesheet count was treated as immutable, requiring TypeScript edits
Technical effects (screenFlash/screenShake/hitStop) were indistinguishable from the actual spritesheet during review

newWorkflow.description: Semantic authoring. The author picks meaning; the resolver produces numbers.
steps: its dedicated preset opens automatically (migrated on first open)
visual spritesheet slots are shown as cards
ADD / REMOVE / REPLACE / MOVE UP / MOVE DOWN spritesheets from the CartoonCoffee library
choose SIZE (LOW/MID/BIG), TIMING (QUICK/NORMAL/LONG), PLACEMENT (AUTO/TARGET/CASTER/GROUND) per slot
choose COMPOSITION (TOGETHER / SEQUENCE / PAIR THEN LAST)
choose TECHNICAL POLISH (AUTO / OFF / LIGHT / STRONG)
PLAY VISUALS ONLY to isolate the spritesheet
PLAY FULL PRESET to evaluate the complete action
newWorkflow.doctrine: 1 action = 1 dedicated preset = 0..N visual CartoonCoffee spritesheets + optional technical polish. Visual slot count is editable without touching TypeScript.

VfxPresetDraft.autoPlacement: TARGET | CASTER | GROUND (derived hint for PLACEMENT=AUTO)

draftSchema.note: No large collection of arbitrary numeric QA overrides is used as the primary authoring representation.

sizeResolver.principle: Resolve to a PREDICTABLE final displayed height by dividing out every runtime multiplier. No double scaling.
sizeResolver.runtimeScaleEquation: finalHeight = stepScale x slotScale x intensity x reducedFactor x contextPresentationScale x targetSizeMultiplier
sizeResolver.resolverFormula: slotScale = targetHeight / (stepScale x intensity x reducedFactor x contextPresentationScale x targetSizeMultiplier)
sizeResolver.lowJustification: 1.55 is the P0.1B human-accepted readability value on the basic tier. LOW is therefore clearly visible by construction and never means 'tiny'.
sizeResolver.tierVerification: Verified identical final height for LOW/MID/BIG across basic (1.00), 2ap (1.05), 3ap (1.12), 4ap (1.30) and 5ap_ultimate (1.55) presentation scales.

timingResolver.principle: Timing derives from native candidate cadence, never fixed AP duration constants. The authored frame sequence is always preserved.
timingResolver.normalJustification: P0.1B human calibration accepted 1.60s and 1.70s for a 1.28s native source (1.25x-1.33x). NORMAL = 1.30x sits inside that accepted band.

visibilityDefaults.principle: Fade controls are NOT exposed in the standard UI. Safe defaults are applied automatically.
visibilityDefaults.fadeOutSemantics: Normalized progress position where the fade BEGINS (VfxSystem.spriteSheetEnvelope). Higher = later = more visible.
visibilityDefaults.a1RegressionGuard: Values 0.08 / 0.10 / 0.18 can never be produced by the resolver.

placementResolver.AUTO: Derived from the action's already-authored anchors/layer at migration time; defaults to TARGET for direct hits.
placementResolver.manualOffsets: Not exposed in the normal Composer UI. Available only under ADVANCED.

choreographyResolver.principle: The user never enters startTime. The Composer computes every start time.
choreographyResolver.SEQUENCE: Cumulative durations: slot N starts when slot N-1 ends.
choreographyResolver.PAIR_THEN_LAST: Slots 1 and 2 start at 0; remaining slots follow sequentially after max(d1, d2). Requires >= 3 slots; below that it is disabled with an explanation.
choreographyResolver.extensibility: Start times are produced by a single pure function keyed on the template, so additional templates can be added without touching compilation or playback.

technicalPolishSeparation.principle: Technical effects are NOT visual slots. They never appear in the spritesheet list.
technicalPolishSeparation.playVisualsOnly: Compiles with includeTechnical=false. Technical array is guaranteed empty.
technicalPolishSeparation.playFullPreset: Compiles with includeTechnical=true. Visual slots are byte-identical between the two modes.

migrationStrategy.candidateLocking: NONE. Seeded candidates are freely removable and replaceable — source selection is now manual.
migrationStrategy.unplayableSourceHandling: A migrated slot referencing a legacy production sheet id (not a CartoonCoffee inventory candidate) is flagged 'NOT A CARTOONCOFFEE SOURCE — REPLACE TO PREVIEW' on the card plus a warning above the preview buttons, instead of silently rendering nothing.

durableState.model: portable JSON bundle -> explicit import -> in-memory store -> SAVE DRAFT -> localStorage cache for THAT browser
durableState.resilience: Bundle import skips individual invalid drafts instead of failing wholesale. Corrupt store data degrades to an empty store.

order: PLAY VISUALS ONLY / PLAY FULL PRESET / SAVE DRAFT
uiLayout.legacyInfrastructure: Preserved intact in CombatVfxLabWorkbench under SYSTEM / DEBUG TOOLS. Nothing was destroyed.
uiLayout.readOnlyTimeline: Computed choreography start times are displayed but have no input controls.

playbackPath: VfxSystem.playLabSpriteSheet — the existing, unmodified candidate playback entry point.

coverage.semanticSizeResolver: tests 1-9 (incl. predictable final height across all 5 AP tiers, no double scaling from intensity / target size / step scale / reducedGraphics)

manualBrowserQa.tool: Playwright persistent contexts (.playwright-composer-a and a FRESH .playwright-composer-b)
